sources.label: Official Rapanui product-page Sizing chart, Centimeters tab (women's plain t-shirt)
Same chart on the women's scoop neck t-shirt

audit: Old URL rapanuiclothing.com/size-guide/ 404s; the Help 'What size should I order?' answer points to the chart on each product page. Product-page 'Sizing' panel: body measurements (bust, waist, hips) for sizes 8-18; printed cm used (Inches tab kept in _in; it is rounded to whole inches). Sizes are numeric only, as sold on the UK store; labels changed from XS-2XL to 8-18. Size 6 removed (not offered or printed); size 18 added. US/EU removed (not printed). Old M (UK 10) 88/70/94 -> 10: 88/70/95; old 2XL (UK 16) 101/83/107 -> 16: 103/85/109.
